title: Koala holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62,42 C64,52 58,60 55,66' stroke='#e8d9b0' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='30' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff5f6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='30' rx='13' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#ff9aa2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='24' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ffd0d4'/>
  <path d='M64,45 l-3,4 l6,0 z' fill='#e0465a'/>
  <!-- koala body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='19' ry='21' fill='#8f9aa8'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='19' ry='21' fill='none' stroke='#b9c3cf' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='77' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#c9d2dc'/>
  <!-- arm holding balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='62' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#8f9aa8' transform='rotate(-25 55 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='62' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='none' stroke='#b9c3cf' stroke-width='1.6' transform='rotate(-25 55 62)'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='66' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#8f9aa8' transform='rotate(15 29 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='66' rx='6' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#b9c3cf' stroke-width='1.6' transform='rotate(15 29 66)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='92' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#7d8896'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='92' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#7d8896'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='11' fill='#8f9aa8'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#b9c3cf' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='6' fill='#e8b9c4'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='11' fill='#8f9aa8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#b9c3cf' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='6' fill='#e8b9c4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='48' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#9aa5b3'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='48' rx='17' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#c4cdd8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- big nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='6' ry='7.5' fill='#3c3550'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='49' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#6f6690'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='44' r='2.6' fill='#20303f'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='44' r='2.6' fill='#20303f'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='43' r='0.9' fill='#b8e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='43' r='0.9' fill='#b8e8ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38,58 q4,3 8,0' stroke='#4a4258' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
